mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 66 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but it will be invisible due to the heavy cloud cover. Tonight's moon phase is a waning gibbous, and we are expecting an overnight low of 58 degrees with rain predicted.

The City of Verona continues to coordinate engineering services with AECOM, and those reports are available online. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding public meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 corridor study to gather community feedback on new design concepts.

There is a busy schedule today including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Thursday night events at ART House 360, more trivia at Hop Haus, and the Main Street Trick-or-Treat event this Thursday.
In a report from October 25, Verona police officers arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was found asleep at the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Butter Pecan is today's flavor of the day. Culver's is currently open, but please note that they are closing soon in 55 minutes, so be sure to get your scoop before they wrap up for the night.
